messages:
inc-bot: PagerDuty P1 -> High egress failure (us-east-1a). Multiple customer reports of outbound connections timing out. Alert: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345. Please ack and triage. Incident ID RWI-2026-438

sofia: ack, I'm on it — taking initial triage. I'm oncall until 09:30 UTC. Starting impact sweep (routes, NAT, security groups).

ryan-net: seeing a config change around 08:02 UTC from infra-automation that touched rt-0a1b2c3d (private-subnet-us-east-1a). The 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0123 route appears removed. Pulling CloudTrail now. @jess-oncall can you confirm the time window?

deploy-bot: Change executed: infra/route-migration (change-id: ch-0f4b2c). User: infra-automation. Time: 2026-03-15T08:02:07Z. Affected: rt-0a1b2c3d.

jess-oncall: taking lead for mitigation. @account_team please prep a customer notification draft. Sofia, scope: which subnets/ASGs are impacted? Kate, can you share quick synthetic checks (curl/traceroute) from an affected instance?

kate-sre: sample from i-0bbf7 (in private-subnet-us-east-1a):

```
$ curl -sv https://ifconfig.co --max-time 5
* Connected to ifconfig.co (35.170.0.1) port 443 (#0)
*   Trying 10.0.1.1...
* connect to 10.0.1.1 port 443 failed: Connection timed out
* Failed to connect to ifconfig.co port 443 after 5001 ms: Connection timed out
```

Traceroute from same host:

```
1  10.0.1.1  0.5 ms  0.5 ms  0.3 ms
2  * * *   (no response beyond subnet router)
```

Also checked NAT gateway nat-0123 in console: status shows "deleted" and creation timestamp 2026-03-15T07:59:40Z. Looks like route removed and nat deleted in close succession.

sofia: confirmed blast radius: private-subnet-us-east-1a (rt-0a1b2c3d) and all instances using that route lost internet egress. A few customers reported API webhooks failing. Severity: customer-facing P1.

david: options for mitigation:
1) Try to re-create same NAT gateway (if EIP available) and replace-route — fastest normal path but NAT creation can take 1-2 mins.
2) Quick failover: create NAT in us-east-1b and replace route to point at nat-0new (reduces single-AZ exposure).
3) Emergency NAT instance (AMI + ip_forward + iptables) as sub-1min fallback if EIPs exhausted.

I'll start option 2; if blocked, spin up option 3.

sofia: go for it. I'm prepping route-table replace commands and will coordinate cutover.

sofia: running create NAT in us-east-1b now.

```
# create nat gateway
aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id subnet-0b2c3d4e --allocation-id eipalloc-0abc1234 --region us-east-1
```

aws output: {"NatGateway": {"NatGatewayId": "nat-0def4567", "State": "pending"}}

deploy-bot: Note: allocation-id eipalloc-0abc1234 assigned by infra-automation pool.

ryan-net: trying route replace to new NAT once NAT becomes "available". Watch for NAT state.

sofia: NAT state now available according to describe-nat-gateways. Executing replace-route: 

```
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rt-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0def4567
```

aws output: {"Return": true}

kate-sre: synthetic check from i-0bbf7 after route replace: 

```
$ curl -sS https://ifconfig.co -m 5
35.170.0.1
# successful, external IP 3.123.45.67 (nat in us-east-1b)
```

jess-oncall: we're seeing recovery on most instances in private-subnet-us-east-1a. Monitoring: egress error rate dropping to baseline. Recalculating incident scope for customers.

david: note — CloudTrail shows deletion of nat-0123 at 07:59:42Z by infra-automation. Need to investigate automation misfire. Also noticed a concurrent route-migration job that removed routes for clean up; race condition likely.

sofia: customer impact: ~12 customers with webhooks/backfills impacted for 7-12 minutes depending on retry. Account team, draft status update: affected customers list attached. Recommend proactive status page and email to top 5.

account_team: drafting now; will push to status.redwood.ai and send prioritized emails to customers with incidents opened on their behalf.

deploy-bot: Deploy audit: infra/route-migration executed two ops in same window: (1) NAT teardown (ch-0f4b2c) and (2) route tidy (ch-0f4b2d). Both started 2026-03-15T07:59:40Z-08:03:00Z.

sofia: mitigation complete; traffic restored at 08:13 UTC. Marking incident as mitigated for customer impact. We'll leave P1 and create postmortem. Oncall handover in 30m to next SRE.

jess-oncall: handing over to @ryan-net for post-incident review. Ryan, please own postmortem and RCA. Include remediation: add automation guardrails (prevent route clean until NAT deletion confirmed), add cross-AZ NATs by default for private-subnets, and add alert to detect route->nat mismatch.

ryan-net: acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem and remediation tasks. Immediate follow-ups:
- Postmortem doc assigned (RWI-2026-438-PM)
- Patch automation to require two-step confirmation on NAT destroy OR auto-update dependent route tables
- Add runbook step to create emergency NAT instance quickly (scripted)

sofia: updating PagerDuty and incident channel with final mitigated note. Customer-impact timeline and contact list appended.

inc-bot: Incident RWI-2026-438 status -> mitigated. Duration 11m. Severity P1. Postmortem owner: ryan-net.

jess-oncall: thumbs up. We'll schedule a 1hr postmortem review in 2 business days. Closing thread for live mitigation. Follow-ups will be tracked in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
